minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, November 16, 2022
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, November 16, 2022.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Lorraine Missick, Bette Donovan and
  Edward Padgett.

  Members absent: Scott Snider, Jenny Jolly and Rafaela Giles.

  Staff Present: Amanda Triay, Community Services Specialist and Yvonne Duran,
  Community Services Manager.

  Guest present: None.

  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, October 19,
  2022 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: None.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program: For the Grab-n-Go meals, meals were distributed to an
  average of 150 participants per week in October.

  Congregate meals: Meals were served to an average of 18 participants per week in
  October.

  Meals on Wheels: 699 meals were served to 41 La Verne recipients in October.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account for the month was $3,401.77.
  Checks written during the October-November statement period included $100.00
  payable to City of La Verne. Justen from Bingo West repaired the pattern display on
  November 1st. He was paid $40.00. The display board is now fully operational.
  Justen noted that the power supply was very warm and we might open the rear
  panel and use a fan to help with cooling. It would also be good to keep the display
  board off when not required. The average number of participants is 66.

5. Account Balance: $8,422.03.

6. Senior Program Fees: All fees have been paid.
 7. MT. SAC Classes: All classes are going well.

8. Aging Next: September and October combined, there were 68 phone calls, 6 home
  visits and 7 in attendance for the Caregiver Support Group.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: The leak in the Senior Craft Room is still a problem and the
  location of where the leak is coming from has not been determined. Veterans Hall
  kitchen update will be started on November 28th. On December 4th, the carpet in
  Community Center hallway will be replaced with carpet squares.

10. Upcoming Events:
  - Wednesday, November 30th – Senior Seminar, 9:30 AM
  - Saturday, December 3rd – Old Town Holiday Stroll, 4:00-8:00PM -
  Opening of Square
  - Monday, December 5th – City Hall Tree Lighting Ceremony, 6:30 PM -
  Santa
  - Friday, December 9th – Senior Seminar, 9:30 AM - Medicare
  - Saturday, December 10th – Winter Wonderland, 9:00 AM-1:00 PM –
  Heritage Park
  - Monday, December 12th – Movie Matinee, 12:30 PM
  - Wednesday, December 14th – Senior Seminar, 9:30 AM
  - Wednesday, December 14th – Excursion: An Evening in Newport –
  Christmas Boat Parade, 2:00 PM
  - Tuesday, January 3rd – Excursion: Rose Parade Float Tour, 9:30 AM
  - Monday, January 12th – Movie Matinee, 12:30 PM

11. Public Comments: George reported that the first golf tournament is at 6:30 AM on
  November 22nd. Three more tournaments will be held this year. The Senior Advisory
  Committee will meet at Chili’s for lunch on December 14th as there will be no
  meeting in December. Lorraine and Bette will pick up Sherry, our Senior Volunteer
  of the year. Yvonne announced the new City Manager is Ken Dohmer as of
  December 19th. The Public Works Director position is still open.

12. Adjourn: It was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting at 11:00 AM. Motion
  carried. The next meeting will be on Wednesday, January 18, 2023, at 10:00 AM.
